summary: F-017 remains open: this fixed snapshot predates the submitted repair and retains incompatible current Q2 production-CI-NEB states across its authority documents.

findings.title: Current Q2 authority documents assert incompatible production CI-NEB states
evidence: The submitted F-017 fix commit 62160f0b05f1ff100ba570de3dcfa8a83597d22f is not an ancestor of c1c6bac94a22f38433a1abb8197839581b69e848; the fixed snapshot retains the pre-fix authority text.
RESULTS_INDEX.md:26 says 'NEB not yet run', while RESULTS_INDEX.md:32 says the PI-authorized q=0+q=+1 production pair ran and both legs converged.

The index names results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/CHARGE_STATE_ANCHOR.md as authoritative at RESULTS_INDEX.md:28-29, but that file says at :4 and :15-16 that a required leg is missing, q=0 is not delivered, and comparison is impossible. It has no current-state supersession banner. results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md:112 retains an unmarked pre-submission decision.

In contrast, results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md:1 says BOTH LEGS CONVERGED. Independent decompression of q0_production/q0_neb.out.gz and q1_production/q1_neb.out.gz found 'neb: convergence achieved' at iterations 36 and 37 respectively, each followed by 'JOB DONE.'

reproduce: rg -n 'NEB not yet run|both legs converged' RESULTS_INDEX.md && rg -n 'One of the two required legs is missing|not delivered|comparison \| \*\*impossible' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/CHARGE_STATE_ANCHOR.md && rg -n 'BOTH LEGS CONVERGED' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md && rg -n 'submission decision is now OPEN' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md && gzip -cd results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q0_production/q0_neb.out.gz | rg 'neb: convergence achieved|JOB DONE' && gzip -cd results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q1_production/q1_neb.out.gz | rg 'neb: convergence achieved|JOB DONE'

proposed_check: C-STATE-003 — discover every Q2 authority named by RESULTS_INDEX.md and require production-NEB state predicates (not-run/missing/pre-launch versus ran/converged) to have one normalized current state or an explicit HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED marker; include a fixture retaining the present index/anchor/gate text and require it to fail.

coverage.method: Following the required authority-first order, inspected the Q2 index, named authority documents, governing protocol/gate, audit record, and both committed production raw outputs through git objects at the fixed commit; then checked the submitted-fix commit ancestry.
not_examined: Scientific-source paths outside the nine Q2 authority/raw paths were not independently re-run in this retry-focused audit.
No remote scheduler, cluster, or instrument state was accessible or inspected.
